definition_zh: 丑角；滑稽可笑的人；粗俗的逗乐者
definition_en: a ridiculous person who clowns about to amuse others
core_image: 翻着跟头的小丑，动作夸张惹人笑
scene: 宴会上他做鬼脸、学鹅走路，把满座逗得前仰后合。The guest acted like a buffoon to keep everyone laughing.
sceneCN: 这里 buffoon 是「丑角、滑稽可笑的人」（第 1 个义项：以夸张滑稽举动逗乐）；句意是这位客人扮丑逗众人发笑。

pos.zh: 丑角；小丑；滑稽粗俗的逗乐者

derivatives.zh: 由 buffoon 加 -ery 构成，义为「滑稽表演，丑态」
由 buffoon 加 -ish 构成，义为「小丑般的，滑稽可笑的」
近义词，义为「小丑」，词源不同

senses.title: A comic performer
senses.definition: a performer who amuses by exaggerated gestures, pratfalls and jokes
senses.definitionCN: 以夸张动作、摔跤和笑话逗人发笑的表演者
senses.example: The medieval court kept a buffoon to entertain the king.
senses.exampleCN: 中世纪宫廷养着弄臣为国王取乐。
senses.why: The Italian source names a trotting dance; a prancing figure became the comic type.
senses.whyCN: 意大利语源词指一种蹦跳的舞，蹦蹦跳跳的身影遂定型为滑稽角色。

senses.title: A ridiculous person
senses.definition: a person whose behavior is absurd and merits ridicule
senses.definitionCN: 言行荒唐、令人嘲弄的人
senses.example: He made a buffoon of himself at the debate.
senses.exampleCN: 他在辩论中出尽了洋相。
senses.why: What begins as deliberate clowning ends as unintentional self-ridicule.
senses.whyCN: 从刻意的插科打诨滑向无意的自取其辱，义项由扮演转为品评。

senses.title: A vulgar jester
senses.definition: one who amuses with coarse, undignified antics
senses.definitionCN: 以粗鄙、有失体统的举动逗乐的人
senses.example: Critics called the satire vulgar buffoonery.
senses.exampleCN: 评论家称这种讽刺是粗俗的滑稽把戏。
senses.why: Low comedy was long despised as beneath refined art.
senses.whyCN: 低级滑稽历来被雅艺术轻视，义项带上了贬抑的道德色彩。

intro.en: Buffoon traveled from Italian through French into English, keeping a dance at its core.
intro.cn: buffoon 经由法语自意大利语传入英语，词核始终是一种舞蹈。

items.en: buffare meant to puff; buffone named a prancing jester, from a trotting dance.
items.cn: 意大利语 buffare 义为喷气，buffone 指一种蹦跳舞的滑稽角色。

items.en: bouffon kept the sense of a grotesque comic figure.
items.cn: 法语 bouffon 保留了怪诞滑稽角色之义。

items.en: buffoon entered English for court jesters and low comics.
items.cn: 十六至十七世纪 buffoon 进入英语，指宫廷弄臣与低俗滑稽演员。

items.en: buffoonery and buffoonish spread the word through moralistic criticism.
items.cn: buffoonery、buffoonish 随道德批评流行开来。

items.en: buffoon now mocks any public figure acting ridiculously.
items.cn: 如今 buffoon 用以讥讽任何举止荒唐的公众人物。

note.en: Buffoon rhymes with a row of -oon words of disguise and stands by the whole clown family.
note.cn: buffoon 与一串 -oon 结尾的词押韵，并与整个「小丑」词族为邻。

entries.definitionCN: 滑稽举动，丑态，buffoon 的派生词
小丑般的，buffoon 的形容词
海盗，只是开头字母相仿，词源无关
闺房，拼形相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a masked comic servant in pantomime
a boastful coward in Italian comedy
entries.definitionCN: 意大利喜剧中虚张声势的懦夫角色

entries.definition: a charlatan who performs to cheat

normalIntro.en: Hear the puff: a buffoon is all blown-up gesture and no substance.
normalIntro.cn: 听那「噗噗」声：丑角全是吹出来的夸张架势。

normal.en: The root buffare means to puff, to blow out air.
normal.cn: 词根 buffare 意为喷气、吹气。

normal.en: Endings -oon mark disguise words: harlequin, pantaloon, buffoon.
Play the buffoon is the set phrase for clowning.
normal.cn: play the buffoon 是「扮丑」的固定说法。

normal.en: Buffoonery adds -ery, the suffix of behavior.
Court jesters were the original professional buffoons.
normal.cn: 宫廷弄臣是最早的职业丑角。

abstract.en: See a man slip on a banana peel on purpose.
abstract.cn: 看见有人故意踩上香蕉皮滑倒。

abstract.en: Hear a whoopee cushion burst in a silent hall.
abstract.cn: 听一声屁垫在肃静的大厅里炸响。

abstract.en: Feel your face stretch into a clown's painted grin.
abstract.cn: 感受脸被小丑油彩扯出的咧嘴笑。

examples.en: The politician dismissed his rival as a buffoon.
examples.cn: 那位政客讥讽对手不过是个丑角。

examples.en: Shakespeare's fools were buffoons with wisdom underneath.
examples.cn: 莎士比亚笔下的弄臣是内藏智慧的丑角。

examples.en: He played the buffoon until the teacher lost patience.
examples.cn: 他一直扮丑作怪，直到老师失去耐心。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不疯」——台上疯疯癫癫，台下说「不疯」谁信？丑角滑稽全靠装疯卖傻。

root: buffoon 经法语 bouffon 源自意大利语 buffone（滑稽角色），其根一般追溯至 buffare（喷气、吹气，拟声），由蹦跳起舞的弄臣定型为丑角；属罗曼语系借词，无古典拉丁直接祖先。

sensesIntro.en: A prancing jester hardens into a comic type, then into any ridiculous or coarse fool.
sensesIntro.cn: 蹦跳的弄臣定型为滑稽角色，进而泛指一切可笑或粗鄙的愚人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a prancing fool blowing air through his cheeks.
core.cn: 核心意象：鼓着腮帮蹦跳的愚人。

intro.en: Buffoon is a borrowed personal noun; its English work is done by suffixes on top of it.
intro.cn: buffoon 是借入的指人名词，英语在其上加后缀派生。

latinIntro.en: No Latin stem exists; the line runs Italian to French to English.
latinIntro.cn: 无拉丁词干可寻，路径为意大利语到法语再到英语。

items.meaning: a foolish old man of comedy
items.exampleCN: 拖着拖鞋的干瘪老头（莎翁语）
